propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity for DCO sign-off.
AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md contain contradictory DCO instructions: some prescribe a specific third-party identity while policy requires real contributor identity.

Documentation must be made identity-neutral by replacing hardcoded sign-off examples with guidance to use configured git user.name and user.email, while retaining bot identity only in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/).
A deterministic linting check must be added to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-offs in contributor-facing documentation files.
The consistency check must scan AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/**/*.md (excluding docs/experiments/) and fail the build if it finds hardcoded Joe Oakhart identity strings.
